integrity: The counterexample and the quantitative Hilbert-space repair are proved directly from synthesis/analysis operator formulas. No numerical experiment, external certification, or unproved computational claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample refutes compactness-only preservation in the scalar Hilbert-space specialization. The stated norm-smallness repair is proved only for ordinary Hilbert frames and is not claimed to be the weakest repair for general Hilbert C*-modules.
title: A rank-one compact perturbation that destroys a controlled \(K\)-frame
